request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide an open, standardized interface so developers and AI agents can discover, integrate, and compose Cardano protocols through a single consistent surface.
The document claims Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and increasing integration cost.
TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with five protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal would fund twelve additional protocol onboardings, three per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage, plus development of the MCP server and skill framework.
The proposal states that protocols including Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens are already accessible through Tx3.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The document claims the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states audit and oversight are included through Intersect administration, technically capable third parties, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The document states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and also received Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month Tx3 expansion covering protocol interface standardization, additional onboardings, agent-facing documentation, an MCP server, and related oversight through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts.
